summary: Downstream method review alerts now remain visible after automatic data refresh.
details: Every explicit method Save, including a no-op Save, acknowledges that method and refreshes its full downstream dependency chain.
Automatically refreshed downstream method outputs remain Needs Review until each method is explicitly saved.
Plain input and formula-calculated datasets remain OK while dependency traversal continues through them to later methods.
Refresh, propagation, and index failures are reported separately from the review status flag.
